title: Cloud metadata service reachability from an application fetch
prerequisites: a server-side fetch whose destination you influence
the instance role grants the metadata service reachability
excerpt: Cloud metadata services answer on link-local addresses and often require a provider-specific request header, which is why a plain fetch can look blocked while the service is reachable. The effect worth proving is the content of a credential document read through the application's own fetch, not the fact that a port answered.
